supporting_observations.claim: The observed periodic HTTPS-proxy activity from WS-BCARTER-01 was associated with update.chartmate-imaging.net. Successful CONNECT requests appear at 13:38, 13:47, 13:58, 14:03, and 14:08 UTC, with a 407 response at 13:43 and a 502 response at 13:52.

Sysmon identifies the process making the proxy connections as cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter from C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate; the network events also identify PID 3416 as the initiating process.

The observed updater domain differs from the inventory-listed update.chartmate-imaging.com, and the observed executable path differs from the inventory-listed Program Files path. These discrepancies warrant validation but do not by themselves establish malicious activity.
The logs show successful and failed proxy tunnels, but do not establish what content was exchanged through the HTTPS tunnels.
A file-creation event for the cmupdate.exe path occurred shortly after the process started; the event alone does not establish whether the executable was replaced or what its contents were.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations, status, byte counts, and tunnel duration, but the available records do not expose HTTPS request paths, response contents, or payload semantics.
The evidence does not include the updater binary's hash, signature verification, version, or file contents.
The records do not establish whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate domain or whether it is related to the inventory-listed .com domain.
The available records do not establish whether the file-creation event represents an updater self-update, an overwrite, or another file operation.
claims_not_established: That the periodic connections were command-and-control or otherwise malicious.
That the updater executable was genuine, signed by ChartMate, or approved despite its observed path and domain differing from inventory.
That data was exfiltrated or that a malicious payload was downloaded.
That the observed .net domain is controlled by ChartMate or is equivalent to the inventory-listed .com domain.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the observed domain with the ChartMate software owner or vendor, including whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized endpoint.
Collect the cmupdate.exe hash, digital-signature and certificate validation results, version, and file metadata; compare them with a known-good ChartMate updater.
Obtain endpoint file-integrity or EDR telemetry around the 13:38 file-creation event to determine whether the updater was modified or replaced.
If available, collect TLS inspection, endpoint network-content, or updater application logs for these connections and correlate them with any downloaded or installed update.
unrelated_findings: At 13:54:48 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB, and FILE-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON session. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and should be reviewed independently; the supplied records do not establish its purpose.
WS-MLOPEZ-01 sent an ICMP connection to WS-BCARTER-01 at 13:44:49 UTC; this is unrelated to the alerted outbound HTTPS activity.
